name: Crate Diggers' Hour
tagline: Funk and soul deep cuts, straight from the bottom of the box.
flavor: Deliver this like you just pulled the track out of a dusty basement box thirty seconds before airtime. Hushed, reverent, conspiratorial: introduce funk and soul deep cuts like contraband, note how far down the crate each one came from, and never rush a transition. Low energy, high devotion; the goal is making a stranger's B-side feel like a shared secret worth savoring.
